title: AI foundation model choice and false positive variation in Anti Money Laundering transaction screening: reproducibility capsule and manuscript package
description: Frozen 12,000-call dataset and deterministic, offline analysis pipeline that reproduces every quantitative result in "AI foundation model choice and false positive variation in Anti Money Laundering transaction screening" (Discover Artificial Intelligence). Five foundation LLMs are evaluated as zero-shot AML screeners over an identical, pre-registered 600-case FATF/SAML-D-anchored battery; per-model false-positive rates span 0.3%-83.0% on identical legitimate transactions. Includes battery generator, frozen capture, paired inferential statistics (Cochran's Q, McNemar exact, Wilson and cluster-bootstrap CIs), SHA-256 integrity receipts, byte-identical replication check, pre-registration, and the manuscript package.
